verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs directly describe identity-event-triggered, no-code automation across hire/role-change/departure — auto-provisioning/deprovisioning access on role change or departure, dynamic group/permission updates, device lifecycle automation tied to hiring/offboarding (auto-ordering devices at hire, auto-retrieval flows at offboarding), and custom workflow triggers for security/compliance. This covers the app-by-app choreography described in the story across multiple product surfaces (IAM, device management, inventory). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these workflows in practice and more detail on the no-code workflow builder UI itself (docs describe outcomes/features but not the builder mechanics).
